items.html: And know that just as the Malchut is called the lower Hochma, so too the Hochma in ZA is called the lower Hochma, with respect to the ancient upper Hochma. And to it he intended in saying, 'these are they who look into the secret of wisdom' — that they look into the internality of the wisdom, this one in ZA, in the secret of the soul, which is the upper Hochma, in the secret of the Daat.
